strings.dares.alldone: Nixie: All three dares. I am out of dares, and slightly impressed.
strings.dares.door: Nixie: That door opens onto nothing. I dare you. Unless you are chicken.
strings.dares.doorchicken: Nixie: Still standing there. I am not judging. I am only logging it.
strings.dares.fellout: You fell out of the world. Back you go.
strings.dares.ffaagain: Nixie: Another round of free-for-all. Counted for today.
strings.dares.ffadone: Nixie: A whole round of free-for-all. You survived, mostly. Dare done.
strings.dares.ffawinagain: Nixie: You won again. Counted for today.
strings.dares.ffawindone: Nixie: First place. I will pretend I expected it. Dare done.
strings.dares.galaxicaagain: Nixie: Stage 3 on Galaxica again. Counted for today.
strings.dares.galaxicadone: Nixie: Stage 3 on Galaxica. The aliens have filed a complaint. Dare done.
strings.dares.hintdesktop: Save yourself! Press {Radial}, then hit Respawn.
strings.dares.hintvr: Save yourself! Click the {WheelStick} stick, look at your {WheelHand} wrist, then hit Respawn.
strings.dares.homeoffer: Nixie: I have three dares for you. Open your menu and press the glowing Dares button. Unless you are chicken. If you take one, find me there first. I will be watching.
strings.dares.jumpagainpaid: Nixie: Again? Show-off. Counted for today.
strings.dares.jumpcaught: Nixie: I fished you out. That one goes down as a fail. Try again, and this time save yourself with Respawn.
strings.dares.jumpdone: Nixie: You saved yourself. I only screamed a little. Dare done.
strings.dares.l.ffa10: Nixie: First of ten. Everybody else is filing a complaint. Dare done.
strings.dares.l.ffa10again: Nixie: First of ten again. Counted for today.
strings.dares.l.team: Nixie: A whole team match. You even passed to someone. Dare done.
strings.dares.l.team5: Nixie: Five on five, and your side won. That is a real battle. Dare done.
strings.dares.l.team5again: Nixie: Another five on five won. Counted for today.
strings.dares.l.teamagain: Nixie: Another team match. Counted for today.
strings.dares.l.teamwin: Nixie: Your team won. I am told you helped. Dare done.
strings.dares.l.teamwinagain: Nixie: Your team won again. Counted for today.
strings.dares.lapdone: Nixie: One lap. I counted. Dare done.
strings.dares.lapnopay: Lap done. Today's jog was already counted. It counts again tomorrow.
strings.dares.lappaid: Nixie: Another lap. Today's jog is counted. Same time tomorrow?
strings.dares.lapstart: Nixie: A lap. I would join you, but I was built for standing.
strings.dares.n.ffa1: Round played. I logged every shot. Most of them missed.
strings.dares.n.ffa2: One round of free-for-all. Shoot things. I will keep score, badly.
strings.dares.n.gal1: Stage 3. The arcade has your number now.
strings.dares.n.gal2: Galaxica, stage 3. The aliens get meaner. So should you.
strings.dares.n.jog1: One lap of the park. I would join you, but I was built for standing.
strings.dares.n.jog2: Today's lap is in the log. Come back tomorrow. I will act surprised.
strings.dares.n.jog3: A new day, a new lap. The park is waiting. So am I, technically.
strings.dares.n.jump1: You jumped and saved yourself. I only screamed a little.
strings.dares.n.jump2: A door, a lot of nothing behind it, and you. Unless you are chicken.
strings.dares.n.plate1: You have one. I had a bet with the vending machine. I won.
strings.dares.n.plate2: A plate is lying around the hub somewhere. Finders keepers. I checked the rules.
strings.dares.n.win1: A win. I printed you a tiny certificate. It is in my head.
strings.dares.n.win2: Win a round. First place. No pressure. Some pressure.
strings.dares.page.alltoday: All of them, today. Come back tomorrow. I will think of something.
strings.dares.page.arena: You are in the hub. The arena is the place.
strings.dares.page.doneagain: Done today. It counts again tomorrow.
strings.dares.page.donebefore: Done before. Today it counts again: {0} gold.
strings.dares.page.doordone: Done. You are here: the door still opens, if you miss the fall.
strings.dares.page.finddoor: You are here. Find the door.
strings.dares.page.foot: Gold for a finished dare arrives with the nightly tally. Every dare is optional, and counts again on a later day.
strings.dares.page.galaxica: You are in the hub. Find the Galaxica machine.
strings.dares.page.lapcounted: You are here. Today's lap is counted.
strings.dares.page.nocheck: You are here, but this world has no checkpoints yet.
strings.dares.page.nodoor: You are here, but this world has no dare door yet.
strings.dares.page.plategoldday: the plate's own {0} gold, then {1} a day
strings.dares.page.platehub: You are in the hub. A plate is somewhere on the floor.
strings.dares.page.runfirst: You are here. Run to the first checkpoint.
strings.dares.page.setbonus: All three of a set: {0} gold on top
strings.dares.page.sub1: All optional. Any order. They come back every day. I noticed you.
strings.dares.page.sub2: All optional. Any order. They come back every day. I will be logging everything.
strings.dares.page.title: Nixie's dares
strings.dares.parkintro: Nixie: A lap of the park. Follow the gold trail through every checkpoint. I will wait here. Standing is my cardio.
strings.dares.parkover: Nixie: Today's lap is counted. Stay for the trees. I will keep standing here, professionally.
strings.dares.plateagain: Nixie: Another head plate. The plate dare is counted for today.
strings.dares.platedone: Nixie: A head plate. A hat made of facts. Dare done.
strings.dares.setbonushead: Finish all three of a set: bonus gold on top
strings.dares.setdone: Nixie: That whole set is done. I will have to think of new dares.
strings.dares.t.hubhunt: Find Nixie's three lost things in the hub
strings.dares.t.hubhunt2: Find the hub's three lost things on another day
strings.dares.t.jump: Jump into the dark, then save yourself
strings.dares.t.team: Play a round of team free-for-all
strings.dares.t.team5win: Win a team match, five on five
strings.dares.t.teamwin: Win a round of team free-for-all
strings.dares.todaybonus: That was today's dare: a bonus on top.
strings.dares.w.arena: the hub's arena, or any free-for-all world
strings.dares.w.ffa: FFA Shooter, a bot plays you there
strings.dares.w.ffa10: FFA Shooter, add 9 bots as host
strings.dares.w.hubbusy: the hub, when it is busy
strings.dares.w.team: SciFi TFFA, or any team match; alone, add bots as host
strings.dares.w.team5: SciFi TFFA, a team match of 10; alone, add 9 bots
strings.first.hintbot: Nixie: Your first mission: finish one round. Grab a gun from a pad. The bot is waiting.
strings.first.hintlap: Nixie: Your first mission: one lap. Follow the gold trail through every checkpoint.
strings.first.hublater: Nixie: The hub is one press away on your Home page. People are better company than bots. Usually.
strings.first.hubline: Nixie: Nice work. The other players hang out in the hub. Want to go meet them?
strings.first.line: Nixie: Pick one. Both work even when nobody else is online.
strings.first.saidbot: Nixie: Good choice. Taking you to the bot. It is not very smart.
strings.first.saidlap: Nixie: Good choice. Taking you to the park. Stretch first.
strings.first.saidlater: Nixie: Fine. Your missions wait behind the glowing Dares button on your Home page.

strings.hunt.banana: Nixie: Oh, and I lost my banana. I do not eat. It was for emotional support. Find it?
strings.hunt.bat: Nixie: Oh, and my baseball bat is missing. I only use it for gentle conversations. Find it?
strings.hunt.cake: Nixie: Oh, and I hid a cake from myself. It worked too well. Find it?
strings.hunt.candy: Nixie: Oh, and my nephew lost his candy around here. He is a toaster. Find it for him?
strings.hunt.chicken: Nixie: Oh, and I lost my chicken. A cooked one. I was keeping it as a pet. Do not ask. Find it?
strings.hunt.dog: Nixie: Oh, and my toy dog ran off. It is a toy. It cannot run. That is what worries me. Find it?
strings.hunt.elephant: Nixie: Oh, and I misplaced a toy elephant. You would think that is hard to misplace. Find it?
strings.hunt.fish: Nixie: Oh, and my fish went for a walk. That is not normal, which is why I need it back. Find it?
strings.hunt.found1: Nixie: You found it. I will pretend I was not worried.
strings.hunt.found2: Nixie: Found it. I owe you one. I will not say which one.
strings.hunt.found3: Nixie: There it is. You are better at this than I am, and I have sensors.
strings.hunt.hat: Nixie: Oh, and I lost my hat. I do not need a hat. That is not the point. Find it?
strings.hunt.horse: Nixie: Oh, and my toy horse is missing. It was the fast one. Find it?
strings.hunt.huball: Nixie: All three found. That is the bonus. I will lose more by tomorrow.
strings.hunt.hubask: Nixie: Three of my things are lost around the hub today. Find all three for a bigger bonus. I would look myself, but I am busy standing.
strings.hunt.hubone: Nixie: That is one. Two more somewhere in the hub.
strings.hunt.hubover: Nixie: You found all three today. I will lose more by tomorrow. It is a gift.
strings.hunt.hubtwo: Nixie: That is two. One more.
strings.hunt.icecream: Nixie: Oh, and I left an ice cream somewhere. It has probably not melted. Probably. Find it?

strings.tour.announce: New: a two-minute tour of the controls. Find it on the Home page of your menu.
strings.tour.both.friends: Invite a friend from Friends. It all runs through Steam, and the game is free, so anyone can join you.
strings.tour.both.gold: You earn gold just by playing. Join a group and you earn together. Spend it in the Store on plates and more.
strings.tour.both.hub: The hub is always open. It is where everyone meets, and the boards there show the top players, groups and supporters. Pick the region nearest you and press Join Hub on Home.
strings.tour.both.ready: Your home is public by default, so your friends and anyone else can drop in. Want it to yourself? Settings, Comfort, Session visibility: Friends Only or Private. When you want people, the hub is waiting. One more thing: this is an alpha, so things will change a lot. Your feedback shapes it.
strings.tour.both.wrong: Stuck or falling: quick menu, Respawn. Want out of anywhere: quick menu, Home. Someone bothering you: Nearby, Mute or Hide. Only you are affected.
strings.tour.complete: Tour complete! Your gold for finishing arrives after tonight's tally.
strings.tour.desk.grab: {Grab} the object on the table. {Use} to use it. {Interact} presses buttons and switches you look at.
strings.tour.desk.look: Move the mouse. This is your home.
strings.tour.desk.menu: {Menu} opens it. Back takes you to Home.
strings.tour.desk.talk: Press {Mic}. It turns your voice on or off for everyone.
strings.tour.desk.wheel: Press {Radial} to open the quick menu. Click what you want.
strings.tour.desk.yours: Settings, Controls: rebind any key, sprint included. Settings, Comfort: turn and movement options. Language: the globe at the top right of the menu. Streaming: Streamer mode hides names and mature content.
strings.tour.hint.desk: Right Arrow: next   ·   End: end tour   ·   ALT: mouse
strings.tour.hint.vr: Point at a button and pull the trigger
strings.tour.offer.body: A few short cards: moving, your quick menu, voice, chat and the menu. Skip any of them, or end it at any time.
strings.tour.offer.body.away: It uses the things in your own place to show you moving, your quick menu, voice, chat and the menu. Head there now and start?
strings.tour.offer.title: Want a two-minute tour?
strings.tour.offer.title.away: The tour happens in your home
strings.tour.travel: Taking you home for the tour…
strings.tour.vr.chat: In the quick menu, pick Chat. Type on the floating keyboard and send.
strings.tour.vr.grab: Squeeze grip on the object on the table.
strings.tour.vr.look: Turn your head. This is your home.
strings.tour.vr.menu: In the quick menu, pick Avatar. That is the full menu. Back takes you to Home.
strings.tour.vr.sprint: Click the {SprintStick} stick while moving to run. Click again, or stop, to walk.
strings.tour.vr.talk: Press the top button on your {MicHand} hand. It turns your voice on or off for everyone.
strings.tour.vr.turn: Flick the {TurnStick} stick left or right. Prefer smooth turning or other movement styles? Settings, Comfort.
strings.tour.vr.wheel: Click the {WheelStick} stick. The quick menu opens on your {WheelHand} hand. Point at it with your {LaserHand} hand and pull the trigger to pick.
strings.tour.vr.yours: Settings, Comfort: swap which hand walks and sprints, put the quick menu and mic button on the other hand, and set turning and movement to your liking. Language: the globe at the top right of the menu. Streaming: Streamer mode hides names and mature content.
strings.v3.contract.hint: Read to the end, then agree to continue
strings.v3.contract.title: Terms of Service
strings.v3.controls.hint: Click a key to change it. Right-click a key to clear it.
strings.v3.fbt.bodyfollows: Body follows head (turn off if your chest twists)
strings.v3.fbt.fadefeet: Fade feet to walk anim while moving
strings.v3.fbt.keepik: Keep IK on a lifted foot while moving
strings.v3.fbt.title: Full Body Tracking
strings.v3.groups.announce.sub: Optional. Shows for members when they open the group.
strings.v3.groups.name: Group name
strings.v3.groups.privacy.hint: Locked after you create the group.
strings.v3.groups.title: Groups
strings.v3.groups.wip: Groups are new. Requests, approvals and mod tools just landed — tell us what breaks.
strings.v3.home.avatars.desc: Customize your look and express yourself.
strings.v3.home.chat.desc: Message your friends and the community.
strings.v3.home.discord.sub: Events, updates and help · opens in your desktop browser
strings.v3.home.fbt.desc: Track your full body and move naturally.
strings.v3.home.friends.desc: View your friends list and join them.
strings.v3.home.nearby.desc: See who's around you in real time.
strings.v3.host.msg: Choose an action and visibility for this world.
strings.v3.host.portal: Drop portal to a new instance
strings.v3.host.title: Host or drop portal
strings.v3.instance.title: Instance
strings.v3.report.msg: Choose a reason for reporting this world.
strings.v3.report.title: Report world
strings.v3.settings.avatarphysics.sub: Tails, ears and hair swing on avatars. Turn off for comfort or on a slower PC.
strings.v3.settings.brightness.sub: Brighten or darken everything. 100% = the world as it was made.
strings.v3.settings.cambody.sub: Also moves your avatar's arms, shoulders and fingers.
strings.v3.settings.camface.sub: Your avatar's face, eyelids and eyes follow your webcam.
strings.v3.settings.camhead.sub: Also turns, nods and tilts your avatar's head with yours.
strings.v3.settings.eyeavatar.sub: Your avatar's eyes follow where you look. Needs a headset with eye tracking.
strings.v3.settings.faceheadset.sub: Your avatar's face follows your own. Needs a headset with face tracking.
strings.v3.settings.fingertracking.sub: Your avatar's fingers follow your controller's finger sensors instead of the preset hand poses.
strings.v3.settings.fov.sub: Desktop only. How wide the view is. Lower feels zoomed in, higher shows more at the edges.
strings.v3.settings.foveatedeyes.sub: With Foveated Rendering on, the sharp area follows your eyes.
strings.v3.settings.fpscap.sub: In VR at least 90 is used. Unlimited leaves it uncapped.
strings.v3.settings.guestinvite.sub: Let anyone here invite people. Off means only you can.
strings.v3.settings.hideavatars.sub: Show everyone as Quinn. Their real avatars come back when you turn this off.
strings.v3.settings.invertmouse.sub: Desktop only. Moving the mouse down looks up.
strings.v3.settings.invertpad.sub: Pushing the right stick down looks up.
strings.v3.settings.mousesens.sub: Desktop only. How far the view turns for a given mouse movement.
strings.v3.settings.proxvoice.sub: Voices fade with distance and muffle through walls
strings.v3.settings.radialhandsub: Laser on the right; quick menu and mic button on the left. Off: the other way round.
strings.v3.settings.resetall.body: Audio, mic, graphics, comfort, colours and controls go back to how they started. Your language, streamer and privacy settings stay.
strings.v3.settings.resetall.title: Reset all settings to default?
strings.v3.settings.sessionvis.sub: Public: anyone can find and join. Friends Only: not listed, friends can join. Private: not listed, invite only.
strings.v3.settings.streammature.hide.sub: Shows them as an orb instead. You can unhide anyone from Nearby.
strings.v3.settings.streammature.quinn: Streamer mode: mature avatars as Quinn
strings.v3.settings.streammature.quinn.sub: While streamer mode is on, other players' Mature Themes avatars show as Quinn.
strings.v3.settings.swaphands.sub: Move the quick menu and Movement Mode to the other hand
strings.v3.settings.uisize.sub: Size of nameplates and on-screen notifications. Larger is easier to read in VR.
strings.v3.settings.voice3d.sub: Hear each voice from where that person is standing: behind you sounds behind you. Off: everyone sounds flat.
strings.v3.settings.webcam.note: Desktop mode only. Pick one: each choice includes the ones above it. Your camera picture never leaves this PC.
strings.v3.store.empty: The store is still in the works
strings.v3.store.emptysub: Check back soon — new items are on the way.
strings.v3.store.sub: Early Access deals — support development and look good doing it.
strings.v3.store.title: VR Realms Store
strings.v3.supporter.activesub: Quick access to favorites and menu colour customization.
strings.v3.supporter.locked: You have plates you cannot wear yet
strings.v3.supporter.lockedsub: Supporters can wear any plate they have found and swap whenever they like. You also get 60 favorite avatars and worlds, plus menu colour customization.
strings.v3.supporter.noavatars: No favorite avatars yet. Heart avatars to pin them here.
strings.v3.supporter.noworlds: No favorite worlds yet. Heart worlds to pin them here.
strings.v3.supporter.platesnote: Every plate you find is yours to keep. Pick one to wear for free — choose carefully, it cannot be changed later. Supporters can wear any of them, and swap whenever they like.
strings.v3.supporter.pricenote: Cancel anytime. Every plate you found stays yours.
strings.v3.worlds.noinstances: No active instances. Host one below.
strings.worlds.hub.sub: The official VR Realms hub — everyone starts here
strings.worlds.hub.title: Join the Main HUB
strings.ws.nosend: Steam is not sending avatars right now. They will show up when it does.
